verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no SharePoint documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The only related item says to use Microsoft Entra ID for authentication to external applications, which is a separate identity platform's capability, not SharePoint's own. A community report also says SharePoint OAuth access cannot be scoped to particular sites, which points the same way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
